description_for_human: Audit & compliance readiness: grounded answers, readiness scoring, gap analysis, and remediation tasks.

functions.name: getReadiness
functions.description: Get overall and per-framework audit readiness (SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR) with the top gaps.

functions.name: getControl
functions.description: Get detail for one control: required evidence, coverage status, and grounded policy citations.

functions.name: askPolicy
functions.description: Answer a compliance/policy question grounded in the approved policy library, with citations.

functions.name: listFindings
functions.description: List open audit findings from prior audits with recommendations.

functions.name: createRemediationTask
functions.description: Create remediation task(s) to close a control's evidence gaps. Requires the AuditAlly.Write scope.

conversation_starters.text: What are the top compliance gaps to fix?
